chunks: Musa ibn al-Qasim narrated from Abu al-Fadl al-Thaqafi, from Abdullah ibn Bukayr, from Muyassar, from Abu Abdillah عليه السلام, who said:
Pray the two rakʿahs of the obligatory tawaf, whether it be after dawn or after afternoon.

key_terms.الْفَرِيضَةِ: the obligatory form, indicating a required tawaf
key_terms.بَعْدَ الْعَصْرِ: after afternoon, another specifically mentioned time
key_terms.بَعْدَ الْفَجْرِ: after dawn, a time specifically mentioned in the ruling
key_terms.رَكْعَتَيِ: the two units of prayer being prescribed here
key_terms.طَوَافِ: the circumambulation of the Kaʿbah, to which this prayer is linked

ai.seo_question: Can the two rakʿahs of the obligatory tawaf be prayed after fajr or after ʿasr?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling concerning the two rakʿahs of the obligatory tawaf. It indicates that they may be performed even after fajr or after ʿasr, showing an exception for this devotional prayer with respect to those times.
